mission: Require Buddy and the model-selection/AI-infrastructure bots to study Chinese and other international open-weight models using current public evidence, reproducible benchmarks, license checks, and local/sandbox evaluation before adoption.
benchmark_requirements: use identical DreamCo fixtures when comparing models
separate vendor-reported benchmark claims from DreamCo-measured results
measure quality, correctness, latency, memory, throughput, cost, tool use, coding ability, reasoning, multilingual ability, and local-device fit where relevant
record exact runtime, quantization, hardware, prompt/template, temperature, context, and grader version
preserve failed, refused, malformed, and timeout cases
retest when model revision, quantization, runtime, or prompt template changes
do not rank a model globally from one benchmark; choose per task and environment
shared_learning: verified model strengths become routing metadata shared across the fleet
verified model weaknesses become benchmark gaps and fallback rules
coding-model gains are shared with coding/build bots
vision/audio gains are shared with multimodal and creator bots
small-model/local-inference gains are shared with mobile/offline/runtime teams
new benchmark fixtures are promoted into the common model-evaluation suite
do not duplicate separate per-bot model research when one shared model registry can serve the fleet
guardrails: do not assume a model is safe, high quality, uncensored, or commercially usable because weights are public
do not execute repository-defined remote code unless explicitly reviewed and allowed
do not ingest restricted, stolen, leaked, or license-incompatible weights
do not expose private user data to remote evaluation endpoints without authorization
do not claim current superiority without fresh reproducible evidence
do not copy proprietary training data or protected outputs into DreamCo
record provenance for every adopted model and quantization
